Description: About The Role RPMGlobal (RPM) is seeking a Computer Vision and machine learning Software Engineer to join our development team and develop algorithms that transform imagery, LiDAR, point clouds, and other sensor data into accurate and actionable information about the physical world. You will work on challenging problems across Computer Vision, machine learning, and 3D geometry, building capabilities used to understand large-scale mining and industrial environments. Your work will go beyond research and prototypes, bringing algorithms into reliable production systems running across cloud and edge environments. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys combining algorithms, machine learning, and strong software engineering to solve complex real-world problems. This is a full-time role, and while it is remote, candidates must be based in Guadalajara. To be considered for this role, please submit your application in English. Key Responsibilities Research, design and implement Computer Vision and machine learning algorithms using C++ and Python. Work on 3D vision problems, including SLAM, Structure from Motion, etc. Train, evaluate, and optimise Machine Learning and Deep Learning models, from dataset preparation/experimentation through production deployment. Optimise algorithms for accuracy, performance, and scalability across cloud, on-premise, and edge environments. Collaborate with development teams and product managers to integrate Computer Vision and Machine Learning capabilities into customer-facing products. Contribute to architecture, code reviews, automated testing, and development standards. About You Relevant tertiary education, such as a Master of Science or PhD in computer science, Computer Vision, robotics, machine learning, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. Experience with LiDAR, point clouds, photogrammetry, SLAM, Structure from Motion, pose estimation, or 3D reconstruction. Strong proficiency in C++ and Python, including performance optimisation, memory management, data structures, and algorithms. Exposure to working with libraries and technologies such as OpenCV, PCL, CUDA, OpenCL, or OpenMP. Experience developing and training Deep Learning models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Ability to optimise Computer Vision or machine learning workloads for GPU and high-performance computing environments. Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Ability to work with large datasets and design robust evaluation methodologies, metrics, and validation workflows. Strong software engineering practices, including code reviews, version control, automated testing, debugging, and profiling. Fluency in Spanish and English. Legally entitled to work in Mexico. Highly Regarded Qualifications And Experience Experience with geospatial applications, coordinate systems, spatial analysis, or large-scale mapping workflows. Experience with autonomous systems, robotics, drones, or multi-sensor platforms. Experience in mining, construction, autonomous systems, robotics, or other industrial environments. About RPM RPMGlobal is the mining industry’s leading enterprise technology and training provider and has been at the forefront of change and innovation in the mining industry for over 50 years. We advance the mining industry towards a safer, more efficient, and more sustainable future through the delivery of innovative software solutions and deep domain mining expertise. Guided by our underlying principles of mining expertise, innovation, and sustainability, we strive to create safer and more efficient operations for our mining customers. Our focus on providing advanced mining enterprise technology and training across the mining lifecycle enables us to guide customers through the industry's current and emerging challenges worldwide. This includes helping them meet the shift in social norms and consumer and investor ESG-related expectations. Please, no agencies or recruiters.

Esta posición tiene un fuerte enfoque estratégico, siendo responsable de evaluar el desempeño de promociones, administrar inversiones comerciales y generar recomendaciones basadas en datos que permitan maximizar el retorno de inversión de las actividades promocionales. Desarrollar análisis y recomendaciones que apoyen la construcción de estrategias promocionales alineadas a los objetivos comerciales del negocio. Colaborar con los equipos de Ventas y Finanzas Comerciales en la elaboración y seguimiento de planes promocionales anuales y trimestrales. Evaluar la efectividad de eventos promocionales y generar insights accionables para optimizar futuras inversiones comerciales. Administrar y monitorear presupuestos promocionales mediante herramientas de gestión comercial, asegurando precisión, cumplimiento de procesos internos y correcto registro financiero. Dar seguimiento a aprobaciones, controles y provisiones relacionadas con inversiones promocionales. Elaborar reportes, análisis y presentaciones ejecutivas para distintos grupos de interés dentro de la organización. Brindar soporte a usuarios de herramientas de gestión promocional y coordinar mejoras o resolución de incidencias con equipos de Sistemas y Servicios Compartidos. Fuertes habilidades analíticas y de resolución de problemas. Inglés intermedio. Experiencia utilizando Nielsen, Circana (IRI) u otras fuentes de información sindicada. Conocimiento de SAP o herramientas de Trade Promotion Management (TPM). Title: HR Data & Compliance Analyst
Description: Description Position at Ziff Davis The Opportunity: Ziff Davis's HR Compliance & Analytics team keeps our workforce data accurate, audit-ready, and useful to the leaders who rely on it. We're looking for an HR Data & Compliance Analyst to be the team's hands-on execution partner: preparing statutory filings and audit evidence, running recurring data validation and reconciliation across our HR platforms, and building and maintaining the dashboards and reporting suites that GMs, HR Partners, and HR leadership use every day. You'll turn raw HCM, payroll, and recruiting data into accurate, audit-ready outputs that leadership can trust. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Manager, HR Compliance & Analytics. You'll work closely with HR Systems on integration health and access reviews, with the HR Coordination team and record owners to fix data at the source, with HR Partners and business leaders on reporting and analysis, and with Legal to track regulatory changes such as new state pay transparency and reporting laws. Our workforce data spans multiple business units, so you'll see how data moves end to end across HCM, payroll, recruiting, and finance systems. This is a remote position. Key Responsibilities: In this role, you will: Build, refresh, and maintain HR dashboards for GMs, HR Partners, and HR leadership, connecting HCM, payroll, recruiting, and finance data, applying role-based security, and supporting users through guides and training to drive self-service adoption. Validate dashboard outputs against source systems before each release, documenting metric definitions and data lineage. Prepare the monthly and quarterly workforce reporting suites, including headcount, hires, terminations, attrition, and span of control by business unit. Test and tune natural-language and AI query tools, logging incorrect answers and maintaining the metric glossary those tools rely on. Fulfill ad hoc data requests from HR Partners and business leaders, turning recurring requests into self-service reports. Pull, clean, and validate data for federal, state, and local workforce compliance filings, and maintain the compliance filing calendar with deadlines, owners, and submission confirmations. Execute scheduled audits of employee files, required system fields, employment eligibility, wage/hour data, and policy adherence, documenting findings and corrective actions. Assemble evidence packages and data extracts for external labor audits, regulatory inquiries, and discovery requests. Run recurring reconciliations across HCM, payroll, recruiting, and finance systems (e.g., change forms vs. HCM records, rosters vs. headcount reports) and drive fixes with record owners and the HR Coordination team. Monitor adherence to field validation standards and mandatory field requirements, reporting data-quality trends monthly. Prepare datasets and first-pass analysis for pay equity, compensation band, and job classification audits, and support predictive model development by sourcing features, cleaning historical data, and tracking model accuracy over time. Coordinate periodic role-based access reviews, from generating user lists and collecting manager attestations to tracking removals to completion. Monitor new-hire provisioning and termination deprovisioning against HR events, and perform daily/weekly checks on HCM integrations and file feeds, triaging failures with HR Systems. Maintain the HR risk register, keeping status, owners, and remediation dates current and preparing summaries for leadership review. Track regulatory changes (e.g., new state pay transparency or reporting laws) and flag impacts on data, filings, or processes. Support annual testing of the HR components of the ADP Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Plans, documenting results and follow-ups. Job Qualifications: Required: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 3+ years of experience in HR analytics, HRIS, HR compliance, or people data operations. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills (lookups, pivots, data cleaning). Hands-on experience building dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a native HCM analytics tool. Working knowledge of US employment compliance and statutory reporting requirements. Experience with an enterprise HCM such as ADP, Workday, or UKG, and an applicant tracking system. High attention to detail and discretion handling confidential employee and compensation data. Preferred: Exposure to multi-entity or multi-country workforce data (e.g., US, UK, India, Australia). Familiarity with API, SFTP, or flat-file integrations, access reviews, and SOX-style control evidence. Experience using or testing generative AI or natural-language analytics tools. PHR, SHRM-CP, or a data analytics certification.
